purpose: Represent a product and manage available inventory by providing validated reservation and release operations on stock.
responsibility: Primary: enforce and apply stock changes with input validation and error signaling. Secondary: hold product attributes (sku, name, price_cents, tags).
mechanism: A dataclass holds product data fields while stock operations validate inputs and mutate the stock field. Methods raise ValueError on invalid quantities or insufficient stock. External callers (ProductCatalog) invoke these operations to coordinate inventory changes.
internal_structure: Domain data fields: sku, name, price_cents, tags
No private helpers; validation and mutation occur within public methods
lifecycle: Instantiated with product attributes and initial stock via dataclass construction
Stock evolves through reserve and release calls
No explicit teardown or disposal behavior
state: stock: available quantity (read and written by methods)
inputs: Initial construction fields: sku, name, price_cents, stock, tags
outputs: No return values from reserve or release
dependencies: ValueError (exception type raised for validation failures)
key_interactions: Called by ProductCatalog to reserve or release product units
Raises ValueError to signal invalid quantity or insufficient stock
errors: ValueError: qty must be positive (reserve, release)
invariants: Reservation requires qty > 0 and qty <= current stock
Stock is not reduced below zero by reserve due to validation
Only reserve and release modify stock in this class
summary: Represent a product and manage available inventory by providing validated reservation and release operations on stock.
